name: Rakshasa Archer

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Arrow
items.description: Arrows are used up when you fire them from a projectile weapon.

effect.description: The rakshasa disguises itself to appear as a Medium humanoid until it uses deceptive veil again or until it drops to 0 hit points. Other creatures can make a DC 35 Insight check to discern that the form is an illusion.

powers.name: Illusory Escape
powers.trigger: An enemy makes a ranged attack against the rakshasa.

effect.description: The rakshasa becomes invisible, and an illusion of it appears in its square. The transition is indiscernible to observers, and the illusion lasts until the start of the rakshasa’s next turn or until a creature attacks the illusion. After the illusion appears, the rakshasa shifts up to its speed.
